title: [maintainer] refactor(ui): split `ObjectGrid.tsx` (7641 lines) into smaller modules, one move-only slice per PR, so concurrent ui cards stop colliding in it
body:
Filing gate **③**: a task the maintainer dispatched, quoted below. Filed by seat `domain:ui#1` (seat post #25966) · `os-steve` · session `session_017iXjUm1rujwDk7f3KT1Pkk`. ⛔ Not a claim.

**The maintainer's words, verbatim** (ui-lane project, 2026-10-26): 「大文件互踩： 立重构卡把 ObjectView 和 ObjectGrid 拆成小模块。这个可以立卡」

**Business reason.** ③, the words above. The ui lane now runs up to ten card threads at once, and two seats. `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx` is one file that many unrelated cards must edit, so the seat has to queue those cards serially by region. That holds whole cards back and causes text conflicts at merge. Smaller modules let two cards that touch different concerns run and land in parallel.

**Reader who acts:** the ui lane seat that owns `@object-ui/plugin-grid`, one dispatch per slice. The first act is a fresh seam table measured at claim.

## Measured (on `origin/main` `05f7758f`, 2026-10-26)

- 7641 lines. Lines 1–1717 are module-level helpers, types and constants. The component starts at line 1718 and runs to the end of the file.
- In flight in this file today: #25977 (server grouping key, in the merge queue), #25987 (default empty state, under review). Re-measure at claim, because the file moves daily.

## The ask

1. **Split along the existing seams,** one area per PR, each slice **move-only**: no logic change, no renamed identifier, and no change to behaviour or to the rendered DOM.
2. **The package's public surface does not move.** Every name `@object-ui/plugin-grid` exports from this file today stays importable from the same entry point. The file itself remains, as the component plus re-exports, so imports by path keep resolving.
3. **Tests stay as they are.** The only test edits allowed are import or `vi.mock` path updates that the move forces, each listed in the PR body. The package's whole test suite is green before and after each slice.
4. **Order.** Start with the module-level helpers (lines 1–1717): pure functions, types and constants that need no shared state. Split the component body only after that, by concern (hooks or sub-components). Where moved code needs component state, pass it explicitly. ⛔ No second copy of a helper, ⛔ no re-derivation.
5. **One slice in flight at a time,** and each lands before the next is dispatched. The card stays open across slices (`Part of #N`); the last slice closes it.

## Dispatch constraint while this card is open

- While a slice is in flight, **no other card edits `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`**. Before a slice is dispatched, the in-flight cards in this file land first. The seat runs this as a serial constraint on its seat post.
- ⛔ `ui/.github/**` and the root `ci.yml` are out of bounds for now (maintainer's word, ui-merge epic in flight). The changeset goes in the root `.changeset/`.

## Duplicate check

`search_issues` on objectstack-ai/objectstack, "split ObjectView.tsx ObjectGrid.tsx into smaller modules refactor large file": 4 hits, none for this file. Shape follows #25522 (engine.ts, move-only slices) and #24586.
